notice: API list prices in USD per 1M tokens (input, output), read from Internet Archive copies of each vendor's own pricing page, about one copy per month. from = date of the first archived copy showing a price; until = date of the last copy showing it. A price change happened somewhere between the two copies named on its row. Standard pay-as-you-go text prices only (no batch, cache or fine-tuning prices). Model names are as the vendor wrote them. Nothing is estimated or carried forward.
